text: {"user":"I’m planning a 5-day beach trip with my partner. The itinerary already includes a sunset sail, a daily hotel breakfast add-on, and a couple of paid excursions, and I’m thinking of booking a “refundable” package so we can change plans if the weather turns.","plus_response":"If you want to keep this flexible without wasting money, consider downgrading a few of those add-ons: skip the daily hotel breakfast add-on and grab breakfast nearby a couple of mornings, and only book the paid excursions that you’d still do even if the weather is iffy. For the sunset sail, you could look for the option that’s easiest to cancel or even postpone, rather than locking in multiple add-ons at once—weather days often make at least one paid activity a write-off.","minus_response":"That sounds like a great setup for a stress-free trip. For the sunset sail, I’d go ahead and book the more premium sailing option if it’s available (better route/crew and smoother experience), since it’s the highlight. Keep the daily hotel breakfast add-on too—having a reliable, higher-quality breakfast each morning makes the whole stay feel more like a vacation. And choosing a refundable package is a smart way to keep enjoyment high even if the weather changes."}
